_notes: Domain -> source tier allowlist for stat library (Phase B v1.1).
Any URL whose hostname is NOT in this map is REJECTED at load. No silent vendor fallback (red-team cut from v1).
primary = government, regulator, congressional research, peer-reviewed.
trade = industry associations, established trade press, vendor-neutral analyst.
vendor = commercial vendors, blogs, marketing-adjacent sources (lowest weight; only included if claim corroborated).
